citation.title: Framework Materials for Full-Arch Implant-Supported Rehabilitations: A Systematic Review of Clinical Studies
citation.authors: Francesca Delucchi; Emanuele De Giovanni; Paolo Pesce; Francesco Bagnasco; Francesco Pera; Domenico Baldi; Maria Menini

s_design.anchor: Systematic review of comparative clinical studies (THERAPY SR/meta-analysis row, 100)
s_design.evidence_quote:
The present systematic review was conducted according to guidelines reported in the
indications of the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
(PRISMA) [13].

The risk of bias of the included cohort studies was assessed using the Newcastle–
Ottawa scale (NOS) [15].
domains.note: Assessment is reported in Tables 2 and 3.

penalties.item: follow-up shorter than the outcome plausibly requires
penalties.evidence_quote:
Finally, the studies included show heterogeneity in their follow-up periods, from a
minimum of 1 year up to a maximum of 15 years follow-up. More caution should be taken
interpreting the results of the studies with shorter follow-up.
penalties.note: The review reports survival outcomes while noting included follow-up as short as one year.

sources.interpretation_fa: این آزمایش آزمایشگاهی مقایسه‌ای نشان می‌دهد زیرکونیای HIP بدون بار مقاومت شکست و تروئنس خارجی بالاتری داشت، درحالی‌که بار تیتانیومی تروئنس مارجینال را بهبود داد. نبود گزارش کورسازی و تخصیص تصادفی، همراه با مدل‌های استانداردشده و پیرسازی کوتاه‌مدت، کاربرد مستقیم نتایج را برای پیامدهای بالینی محدود می‌کند.
